run_interoperability_test: run the gRPC interoperability test client against a server with a specified test case
parse_interop_client_args: parse command line arguments for the gRPC interop test client including server host and port
create_secure_channel: create a secure gRPC channel with TLS, ALTS, or compute engine credentials
create_stub: create a TestServiceStub or UnimplementedServiceStub from a gRPC channel based on the test case
create_call_credentials: create gRPC call credentials using OAuth2, compute engine, or JWT token authentication
